argument: The departure must live in the route bodies: the local letter must contract an actual segment and the remote letter must acquire an actual segment. A bright line, cursor, or status readout cannot substitute for changed route geometry.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, captions, and furniture hidden, the first field should read as one sparse three-dimensional rack of routed letter bodies, not a refusal plate, sentence corridor, word-card grid, or decorative 2D text field. After departure, the local gap and remote spare must be findable in the bodies themselves.

Proximity must remain memory-neutral. Only a real withdrawal across the threshold, the deterministic action, Enter, or Space commits; Delete restores the exact preceding rack and R releases bounded custody.

v026 changes representation to custom routed letter skeletons, medium to p5.js WEBGL, and encounter to approach/withdrawal. The rupture must be visible in code, input, depth composition, and the changed local/remote geometry.

little-critters is translated from situated attention into non-local typographic custody. No animals, eyes, paper setting, head-turning image, source palette, composition, code, or API surface may carry the relation.
